categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Adds the `IsSymlink` utility function in `src/util/fs_helpers.cpp` and `src/util/fs_helpers.h` to handle Windows reparse points.
categories.rationale: It introduces a cross-platform filesystem helper in `util/fs_helpers` to work around GCC's `libstdc++` lack of symlink detection on Windows. This is a clean utility improvement that resolves broken standard library behavior on Windows.

categories.name: wallet
categories.rationale: It fixes wallet directory traversal and wallet loading on Windows by properly detecting symlinks. While symlinked wallet paths on Windows are an edge case, this fixes incorrect directory recursion in `ListDatabases` and re-enables functional test coverage on Windows.
